name: Conversica
tagline: Conversica provides AI Revenue Digital Assistants that autonomously engage leads via email and SMS with human-like two-way conversations. The AI follows up persistently until prospects are ready to talk to a human, qualifying them and booking meetings. Marketing and sales teams use it to ensure no lead is left uncontacted.
